title: Pregnancy-related mortality trends
subtitle: Direct estimates of pregnancy-related mortality rates for the 7 years preceding each survey, by 5-year age groups, Kenya 2025/26

footnotes.note: 1 Pregnancy-related mortality is defined as the death of a woman while pregnant or within 2 months of termination of pregnancy, from any cause including accidents or violence
3 Age-adjusted rate expressed per 1,000 women age 15-49
4 Expressed per 100,000 live births; calculated as the age-adjusted pregnancy-related mortality rate times 100 divided by the age-adjusted general fertility rate
5 Calculated as 1-(1-PRMR)TFR where TFR represents the total fertility rate for the 7 years preceding the survey
